assets.caption: EXHIBIT 3-25 Typical Process Unit Road and Paving Arrangement
assets.notes: Plan view drawing of a typical process unit showing road and paving arrangement. Rectangular unit bordered by auxiliary roads on the perimeter; labeled paving zones include AUXILIARY ROADS, CRUSHED STONE, SPUR ROAD, HEAVY PAVING, ACCESS WAY (horizontal mid-unit), and LIGHT PAVING. Multiple rows of equipment (vessels, exchangers) arranged pipe-rack-style with hatched areas indicating different paving treatments.
